subject: religious-studies

items.q: Do all religions worship in the same way?
items.correct: No — prayer, festivals and rituals vary greatly between and within religions.
items.why: Forms of worship reflect each tradition's beliefs and history.

items.q: Are religious festivals just holidays with no meaning?
items.correct: No — they commemorate important beliefs and events.
items.misconception: Yes, they are only days off.
items.random_wrong: Festivals are banned in most religions.
items.why: Festivals carry deep significance and teach core beliefs.

items.q: Are sacred texts read literally by all believers?
items.correct: No — interpretation ranges from literal to symbolic.
items.why: How texts are understood varies between and within religions.
